Button.OpenTooltip: Browse scenes from every module, active or not

Open.Name: Open Scene Browser
Open.Hint: Opens the browser of all scenes from modules, the system and the world.

Notices.NoFileAccess: This Foundry version does not serve compendium database files to the browser. Scenes of inactive modules will be available only from a previously built cache.
Notices.IndexerNotYet: The indexer is not implemented yet (phase 2).
Notices.CacheEmpty: The cache is empty. Click Index to read compendium files of inactive modules; active packs, the system and the world are shown live.

ImportFolder.Name: Folder for imported scenes
ImportFolder.Hint: Root world folder for imported scenes; each scene is placed under it in “module › inner folder” subfolders. Leave empty to nest directly by module.

IndexActivePacks.Name: Also index packs of active packages
IndexActivePacks.Hint: Read the database files of active packs too, to get wall/token/light counts. Costs extra download on the first run; later runs only re-read changed packs.

RememberState.Name: Remember browser state
RememberState.Hint: Keep the search, filters, expanded tree nodes and the last selected scene between sessions.

ShowInactive.Name: Show inactive modules by default
ShowInactive.Hint: Whether scenes of inactive modules are visible when the browser opens.

CacheDir.Name: Cache folder
CacheDir.Hint: Folder inside Data where the scene index is stored (one file per pack, versioned). Default: elfrey-scene-browser

Errors.UploadFailed: The server did not accept the cache file.
Errors.SceneNotFound: Scene not found in the pack.
Errors.PackNotConnected: That compendium is not connected (module disabled).

Indexing.Title: Indexing scenes
Indexing.Hint: Only packs that changed since the last run are read again. The download estimate covers pack database files only; thumbnails are not loaded.

Plan.Api: Connected packs to read through the API
Plan.Unavailable: Unavailable (files not served, pack not connected)

Indexing.Cancelled: Indexing cancelled; packs finished so far were saved.
Indexing.StaleFiles: {count} superseded cache file(s) can be deleted by hand from {dir} (Foundry does not let a module delete files).

Details.None: Select a scene to see its details.
Details.InactiveNote: Module is disabled: importing re-reads the pack; linked actors are not resolved.
